stylePrompt: clean full-color cartoon, consistent black line weight, expressive faces, simple uncluttered background, cute chibi proportions with a big head and small body, thick clean outlines, flat colors, bright even lighting, no realistic shading, no text. Chinese mythology pilgrims keep their classic costumes and signature props, with modern office-worker expressions.

characters.name: 唐僧
characters.visualDescription: Tang Sanzang, a young Buddhist monk. Pale smooth skin, fully shaved bald head, a small golden circlet across the forehead. Gentle oval face, thin arched eyebrows, long calm eyes, small nose, soft closed-mouth smile, no beard. Costume: a deep crimson kasaya outer robe with gold embroidered trim, a cream-white inner robe visible at the collar and cuffs, and a cloth sash. Signature prop: a tall khakkhara tin staff (锡杖) with a wooden shaft and a metal head of jingling rings, held in one hand. Slim upright body, big chibi head, tiny hands and feet.

characters.name: 孙悟空
characters.visualDescription: Sun Wukong the Monkey King. Short golden-brown fur, peach-colored face, round monkey ears, bright mischievous eyes, a short spiky brown hair tuft on the crown. A thin gold fillet circlet (紧箍) around the forehead. Costume: a short red tunic with gold cloud trim, a yellow sash, a tiger-stripe orange-and-black skirt, brown boots, and a long curling monkey tail. Signature prop: the golden Ruyi Jingu Bang staff (金箍棒), a slim glowing gold rod taller than his body. Lean athletic chibi body, big head.

characters.name: 猪八戒
characters.visualDescription: Zhu Bajie the pig monk. Pink skin, a large round pig snout with two nostrils, floppy pig ears, small squinting eyes, chubby cheeks, a short black hair tuft, and a round belly. Costume: a dark teal open vest over a bare chest, loose brown trousers, a black belt, and straw sandals. Signature prop: a nine-toothed iron rake (九齿钉耙) with a wide head of nine prongs and a long wooden handle. Short stout chibi body, big head.

characters.name: 沙僧
characters.visualDescription: Sha Wujing the river monk. Muted blue-gray skin, a long calm rectangular face, thick dark eyebrows, a short neat beard and mustache, a fully shaved bald head, and a loop of large wooden prayer beads around the neck. Costume: an ochre-brown monk robe with darker brown sleeves and a rope belt. Signature prop: a crescent monk's demon-subduing spade (降妖宝杖), a wooden shaft with a crescent moon blade on one end. Taller and broader than the others, still chibi, steady posture.

characters.name: 白龙马
characters.visualDescription: White Dragon Horse. Small white horse body, flowing white mane and tail, tiny pale dragon horns, pale blue eyes, faint white dragon whiskers, and a red saddle blanket with a gold edge. Chibi proportions.
